mapper.sql: (SELECT d.transfer_id, COUNT(*) AS line_count, COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS total_qty, COALESCE(SUM(d.settle_amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM org_transfer_detail d WHERE d.deleted = 0 GROUP BY d.transfer_id)
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.transfer_no AS transferNo, t.from_factory_id AS fromFactoryId, ff.name AS fromFactoryName, t.from_warehouse_id AS fromWarehouseId, fw.name AS fromWarehouseName, t.to_factory_id AS toFactoryId, tf.name AS toFactoryName, t.to_warehouse_id AS toWarehouseId, tw.name AS toWarehouseName, t.status, t.audit_time AS auditTime, t.remark, t.create_time AS createTime FROM org_transfer t LEFT JOIN org_factory ff ON ff.id = t.from_factory_id AND ff.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_factory tf ON tf.id = t.to_factory_id AND tf.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_warehouse fw ON fw.id = t.from_warehouse_id AND fw.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN base_warehouse tw ON tw.id = t.to_warehouse_id AND tw.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.id = #{id}

SELECT d.id, d.material_id AS materialId, m.code AS materialCode, m.name AS materialName, d.qty, d.cost_price AS costPrice, d.settle_price AS settlePrice, d.settle_amount AS settleAmount FROM org_transfer_detail d LEFT JOIN base_material m ON m.id = d.material_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.transfer_id = #{transferId} ORDER BY d.id

SELECT t.from_factory_id AS fromFactoryId, ff.name AS fromFactoryName, t.to_factory_id AS toFactoryId, tf.name AS toFactoryName, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS transferCount, COALESCE(SUM(d.qty), 0) AS totalQty, COALESCE(SUM(d.settle_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM org_transfer t JOIN org_transfer_detail d ON d.transfer_id = t.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_factory ff ON ff.id = t.from_factory_id AND ff.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_factory tf ON tf.id = t.to_factory_id AND tf.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = 1 AND t.audit_time >= #{from} AND t.audit_time < DATE_ADD(#{to}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY t.from_factory_id, ff.name, t.to_factory_id, tf.name ORDER BY totalAmount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM base_material WHERE id = #{materialId} AND deleted = 0
